correctness.rationale: At the predator-free state \(\bar x=r/a,u=0\), the prey diagonal derivative is exactly \(-r\), and the predator block decouples at first order because every derivative of \(B(x,\tau)u\) or \(\mu(x,\tau)u\) with respect to prey is multiplied by \(u=0\). Solving the linear age equation gives the displayed Euler--Lotka equation. The triangle inequality excludes any characteristic root with nonnegative real part when \(\mathcal R_P<1\), while continuity and strict decrease in the real exponent give a positive real invasion root when \(\mathcal R_P>1\). The source logistic juvenile indicator is strictly positive at every finite positive age, which makes \(\mathcal R_P(g)\) strictly decreasing; dominated convergence gives its zero limit. The finite-lifespan verification script independently stress-tests these identities but is not used as the proof.

originality.rationale: The motivating source numerically maps predator-free behavior in the \((\tau^*,g)\)-plane and identifies \(g\) as highly influential, but its inspected full text contains no net-reproductive-number or Euler--Lotka invasion theorem. Generic structured-population threshold ideas are known, so the originality claim is deliberately source-specific: the exact reproduction functional for this role-reversal model, its strict/complete monotonicity in the juvenile-consumption parameter, and the resulting unique critical \(g_c\).
residual_risks: Generic renewal-equation theory makes Euler--Lotka threshold reasoning classical; originality is only claimed for the explicit role-reversal functional, its strict/complete monotonicity in \(g\), and the unique source-specific cutoff.
A broader literature not surfaced by the searches could contain a mathematically equivalent monotone-hazard lemma, but no inspected source applies it to this model or states the same implication.
The result is local invasion theory and should not be read as a global classification of the nonlinear phase diagram.

value.rationale: The source expends substantial simulation effort on predator-free classification and identifies juvenile consumption \(g\) as one of the two most influential parameters. The theorem converts that empirical direction into an exact one-dimensional invasion law: at fixed maturation age, the local invasion boundary in \(g\) can be crossed at most once, and a scalar renewal integral replaces repeated local stability computations. This isolates the biological juvenile bottleneck mechanism and gives a principled diagnostic for phase-diagram calculations without claiming a paper-sized global dynamics result.
